# Video & Audio Production

## Overview
Video and Audio Production at Neon Vision is a technical framework for creating broadcast-ready assets using advanced AI and human engineering workflows. The process combines structured production timelines, spatial audio engineering, and AI-assisted pre-production to ensure high-quality, data-driven results across multiple formats and platforms.

## Production Timelines & Workflows
- **Standard Cycle**: 7-day delivery for full production.  
- **Rush Cycle**: 5-day delivery for high-priority projects.  
- **Music-Specific**: 3-day mixing, 2-day mastering; 72-hour turnaround for premium tiers.  
- **Technical Platforms**: Hybrid workflow integrating SSL consoles, UAD plugins, and digital platforms like Pro Tools HD, iZotope, and Manley.  

## Technical Engineering & Audio Mixing
- **Spatial Audio**: Object-based Dolby Atmos and immersive 3D audio optimization for headphones and mobile devices.  
- **Music Production**: Human + AI-assisted mixing;
